accountId.title: Account Id
accountId.description: Salesforce Id of the Account to update (starts with 001): the record the user is viewing, or the accountId returned by Find Accounts.

accountType.title: New Type
accountType.description: New Account type, e.g. Prospect, Customer - Direct, Customer - Channel. Leave empty to keep the current value.

annualRevenue.title: New Annual Revenue
annualRevenue.description: New annual revenue in US dollars as a plain number, e.g. 25000000 for 25M. Leave empty to keep the current value.

industry.title: New Industry
industry.description: New Industry, e.g. Technology, Finance, Healthcare, Retail, Energy. Leave empty to keep the current value.

rating.title: New Rating
rating.description: New Account rating. Allowed values: Hot, Warm, Cold. Leave empty to keep the current value.
